instruction: Use the opened Autodesk Revit environment and its automation interfaces to export the completed model to C:\Users\user\Desktop\result.ifc as IFC4. Use `C:\Program Files\Autodesk\Revit 2025\Revit.exe` as the Revit entry point for this automation. Do not create, rewrite, patch, copy, or post-process IFC outside Revit. The current model is a two-storey clinic shell with broad undifferentiated floor plates. The practice manager wants each floor organized into waiting, exam, staff, and store zones while preserving the compact massing and floor-to-floor relationship. Evaluation requirements: the identifiers, counts, relationships, properties, and numeric ranges in the following JSON are explicit task requirements: {"absent_space_tokens":["Ground Clinic","Upper Clinic"],"bbox_ranges_m":{"x":[13.4,15.2],"y":[9.4,11.2],"z":[4.9,6.5]},"exact_counts":{"IfcBuilding":1,"IfcBuildingStorey":2,"IfcProject":1,"IfcSite":1,"IfcSlab":2,"IfcSpace":8,"IfcWall":12},"forbidden":["IfcBeam","IfcBuildingElementProxy","IfcColumn","IfcCurtainWall","IfcDoor","IfcRoof","IfcWindow"],"min_counts":{},"min_file_bytes":20000,"min_shaped_products":16,"space_levels":{"Exam":0,"Exam Upper":1,"Staff":0,"Staff Upper":1,"Store":0,"Store Upper":1,"Waiting":0,"Waiting Upper":1},"space_tokens":["Waiting","Exam","Staff","Store","Waiting Upper","Exam Upper","Staff Upper","Store Upper"],"storey_tokens":["Ground Floor","Level 2"]}.
